recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中可見多顆異常淋巴細胞，核深染且呈不規則分葉或卷曲，細胞質少，數量明顯增加，符合 ATLL 周邊血侵犯；個別核的花瓣狀細節需高倍確認。
features: Increased numbers of atypical lymphoid cells in a low-power field
Irregular, lobulated or convoluted, hyperchromatic nuclei
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with high N:C ratio
Mild variation in cell size among the atypical lymphoid cells
Normochromic, normocytic red cells with scattered platelets
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregularly lobulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Red cells are normochromic and normocytic, and platelets are present. The magnification limits evaluation of fine nuclear detail, but the nuclear irregularity and lymphocytosis are evident. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, to be confirmed by higher-power review, HTLV-1 serology and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have finely cerebriform nuclei and occur with erythroderma, and are HTLV-1 negative.
CLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and frequent smudge cells rather than lobulated nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells rather than uniform lobulated nuclei with scant cytoplasm.
FL cells are small with deeply cleaved nuclei and are CD10+ BCL2+ B cells rather than CD4+ CD25+ T cells.
